A diode conducts current easily when forward-biased (low resistance) and blocks current when reverse-biased (high resistance).  
Option (A) is wrong because it says high resistance in both directions.  
Option (C) is wrong because it swaps forward and reverse bias resistance.  
Option (D) is wrong because it says low resistance in both directions.  
Option (B) matches the correct behavior.  

Final answer: (B)
